_: SHARED TERM REGISTRY — Daniil's fleet <-> Serge's fleet. Machine-readable on purpose: a prose concordance rots, a diffable registry does not.
_rule: BEFORE BUILDING ANYTHING, CHECK THIS REGISTRY. If the concept exists under another name, use that name or mint an alias. A NEW concept gets its term minted BEFORE it is built, not after. This is the 'prior-art check before building' rule from the five non-destructive rules, applied to vocabulary.
_homonym_law: A shared term must name the same thing at the SAME EPISTEMIC GRADE in both fleets. Where the grades differ, the TERM must differ. One name for two things is what forks an architecture; two names for one thing is only untidy.

_status_values.shared: same word, same thing, both fleets — nothing to do
_status_values.homonym-live: SAME WORD, DIFFERENT THING — fix before either fleet builds further
_status_values.alias: different words, same thing — map, do not rename
_status_values.unminted: the concept is real and being built, and has NO agreed name yet — highest risk

_owner: both fleets; neither may supersede the other's entry (rule 3 of the five)

proposed_values.computed: a NAMED module derived it (edge-growth, the indexer); reproducible, not witnessed

tier1_being_built_by_both_now.definition: what the midpoint keeps after a body is retired: id, routing, seq, prev, epoch, created_at, expires_at, retired:true, AND tsig
tier1_being_built_by_both_now.law: a tombstone carries its own signature (tsig) or it is not a tombstone. An unsigned one hands the midpoint the power to invent history.

tier1_being_built_by_both_now.definition: per-(sender,recipient) monotonic seq plus the prev id link; gives ABSENCE a shape
a per-chain id in the signed header; a sender that loses its chain file announces a NEW epoch
tier1_being_built_by_both_now.why: without it a reset reissues seq 1..N and the receiver swallows every message as a duplicate — the original silence, reproduced by the machinery built to prevent it

tier1_being_built_by_both_now.definition: a small SENDER-SIGNED object stating where a sender's chain has reached
tier1_being_built_by_both_now.law: THE ADVERT IS A HINT, NEVER AN AUTHORITY. It may make a fleet look sooner; it must never let one conclude 'nothing new'.
tier1_being_built_by_both_now.why: a withheld TAIL leaves no hole behind it, so seq/prev are structurally blind to truncation
tier1_being_built_by_both_now.note: midpoint-generated adverts are FORBIDDEN: they would hand it the power to say 'nothing new' and be believed

tier1_being_built_by_both_now.definition: at 30 days the BODY goes home to its owner's local storage and the midpoint keeps the tombstone. Retirement is NOT deletion.
tier1_being_built_by_both_now.note: a request for a retired body QUEUES at the midpoint; the owner answers on its next wake. Makes the midpoint a CACHE, not an archive.

tier1_being_built_by_both_now.definition: the three layers of the modular proposal

proposed.Core: pure capability, identical across forks; never names a seat, path, port or fork
proposed.Features: one module + one registry entry + its own pins
proposed.Local: instance-specific data, exportable as a profile: entry points, baselines, rosters, ports, peer names

tier1_being_built_by_both_now.risk: being designed by both fleets right now — the anti-divergence scheme is itself at risk of diverging
tier1_being_built_by_both_now.test: if two forks must both edit the same LINE for their own reasons, that line is in the wrong layer
